integrity: Proof derives exact recurrences and gamma-ratio asymptotics; included rational finite-state enumeration checks identities but cannot establish infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed real attachment offset greater than minus one; only distinguished initial root degree and total leaf count. No central limit theorem, maximum-degree statement, or uniform boundary-parameter estimate. Originality is provisional against undiscovered broader joint-moment theory.
title: Sharp root-degree–leaf-count covariance in affine preferential-attachment trees
